close.rep_takeaway: The inbound tells you what someone typed into a form, not why the company is moving now. On the first call, ask who feels the pain and what changed recently. A new CFO with a nine-day close was the deal, and we found her only after a portal proposal stalled. When something wins the deal, like the business case built on her own statements, write the numbers into the CRM that day so the next rep can reuse them.
